d:
Gold mining takes more than hard work. When massive machines break down in the middle of the wilderness, every repair becomes a race against time. From heavy equipment failures to challenging field repairs, the Gold Rush crews must find ways to keep their operations running.
In this Season 3 compilation, revisit the mechanical setbacks, equipment troubles and demanding repairs that put the miners’ plans to the test. With time and gold on the line, can the crews get their machinery back in action before the breakdowns cost them too much?
